snippet.title: Petit Planet gamescom 2026 Special Video
snippet.description:
Petit Planet launches in Winter 2026. See you where the stars bloom.

From August 26 to August 30, Petit Planet will be at gamescom 2026! We warmly welcome Planet Tenders from around the world to stop by and try out the game! 

Pre-register Now: https://hoyo.link/OYYY0v2Y5
